title: Diplomatic Entities
description: Schema for the diplomatic directory: foreign missions, consulates, and international organizations accredited to or hosted in the Philippines. Generated from TalaCMS's DiplomaticEntity model by `npm run cms:fetch`; one CMS model, discriminated by entityType, grouped into three arrays.

contact.description: Contact phone numbers, semicolon-separated; may carry TL/F/TF suffixes

email.description: Email address (can contain multiple addresses separated by semicolons)

website.description: Official website URL, with or without protocol

title.description: Title of the representative (e.g. Ambassador, Consul, Nuncio). Null on records where TalaCMS carries no title; null is preserved rather than omitted so the generated file matches its tracked fixture.

Diplomatic Mission.description: Embassies and high commissions of foreign states in the Philippines. The only group carrying slugs.

office_name.description: Official name of the diplomatic mission

representative.description: Name of the head of mission

Consulate.description: Consulates and honorary consulates. Carry no slug — they have no detail route.

International Organization.description: Multilateral bodies hosted in the Philippines. Named by organization_name and headed by `head`, not `representative`; carry no country and no slug.

head.description: Name of the resident representative or head of office
